title: Your own render test on the iPhone: original (A) vs best build (B)
instructions: The phone is locked for you until 01:54 +07 (no agent will touch it). A = original Fastwork: http://192.168.0.55:5611/ . B = best build so far (wave-1 fixes + nav-morph pin + countdown repaint + card reveal + mid-page F3): http://192.168.0.55:5647/ . Open each in Safari and scroll/swipe however you like. When finished press Done and write in the notes what you felt (which is smoother, where it still lags: hero, people card, mid-page, end of page).

result.notes:
i was test on the hero section and the end of page, the B quite smoother.
i was see the style recalculation was took around ~19-20ms sometime. so there cause the lag.

for example we render on 60hz , so perfectly we have a budget each frame is 1s/60 = 0.016 s per frame = 16ms. more than that it will be lag.

i suspect 2 things
- nested css, they will be cause from query the complex from dom. nested css will raise more complexity to find the element.
- image size. render trigger. for example image have to rotate, i'm not sure resize or not. the engine have to calculate every frame that change. 
   * can we reduce the image size ? 
   * can we reduce trigger of render cap in 60 frame. maybe use native css for direct engine use optimized logic for handle them
